comment: NOT USED BY ANY BUILD. Reference for reviving seasonal events (docs/EVENTS.md): the pieces of the Halloween Heat (2019) prototype that ran on 2026-10-10. To try it, copy the optional group, the patches and the content patches into a copy of patches/trials-frontier-7.9.0.json and build with --with event-tab-icon,halloween-heat (apply_patches.py / build.py, build_ipa.py --spec). Untested as one piece: the prototype dropped the item-22 condition in memory, not with the data edit below.

optional_groups.event-tab-icon: Per-event special event button icon: the running event's mission data names the texture; default the shipped holly.
optional_groups.halloween-heat: Halloween Heat 2019 (Treasure Hunt + Count Dracuul) moved by seven years to 2026-10-19..11-12, with a Halloween button icon.

replacement_asm: helper(x0 = type-13 override or 0) -> w0 = texture id:
patches.function: code cave for the special event button icon
patches.reason: The special event button icon is one texture, /MENUZ/ICON/SPECIAL_EVENT_MAP_BUTTON.PNG (hash 0xd32385fe), whose art Ubisoft replaced for each event; the last build (Christmas 2019) ships the holly, so every event shows it. Let the running event choose: the int custom value getHashCode("EventTabIcon") (0x6a420739) of the event mission's type-13 override names another texture (its name hash); none -> the holly as before. Both places that show the button use it: the World Map tab (initSpecialEventContainer, hard-coded hash) and the home screen button 11 (layout 4b761f6c, checkSpecialEventPopup).

content_patches.reason: Seven years (2557 days: 2020 and 2024 are leap years) keep the weekdays and the time of day. 448 also needs item 22/1 >= 10 (unknown counter; 0 for the developer's veteran save, so the event never starts): drop that condition.
Made from the player's own pack at build time: the holly button (/MENUZ/ICON/SPECIAL_EVENT_MAP_BUTTON.PNG, d32385fe) with the holly removed and the pack's jack-o'-lantern with bats (ceedfafa) on top.
